description.value: A ContactPerson (ContactPersoon) as used within the medical record (Dossiergegevens) section in the ELZ data set. It is based on the zib ContactPerson as much as possible, but adds some elements that are necessary for data exchange in the primary care domain.

purpose.value: A derived profile from [nl-core-ContactPerson](http://nictiz.nl/fhir/StructureDefinition/nl-core-ContactPerson) to provide a version better suited for use in ELZ use cases.

comment.value: Relation with the ELZ data set.

definition.value: Additional information about the contact. For example, information such as 'the father is also a medical doctor' can be included here. In addition, if the contact works at an organization, the organization can be mentioned here. If the organization is listed as a contact and no actual contact is known, this can also be stated here. In this case, the name information can be left blank.

short.value: Defines the contact’s familial relationship to the patient.

definition.value: The relationship defines the contact’s familial relationship to the patient.

In primary care use cases often SNOMED is used to convey information on the role of a contact person. In order to be zib compliant the ConceptMap <http://nictiz.nl/fhir/ConceptMap-RolSnomedCodelijst-to-RolCodelijst> can be used to relate these two ValueSets. The SNOMED code can be conveyed via the dedicated slice.

description.value: Use ConceptMap RolSnomedCodelijst_to_RolCodelijst to translate terminology from RolSnomedCodelijst to RolCodelijst.
